items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: We had another professor then by the name of Frank Welch... And he taught us and played coinette along with us.

ctx.x: Just about where was that in the Jefferson?

About one mile and a quarter out of the city limit. And we used to have to meet Professor Umphrey every Sunday morning about 9 o'clock. We had a little road cart. We'd carry him, flurry and two. And so the people that I wait for, they give us a place that we could have our practice, take our lessons, and might near every night while we was there playing and doing the best that we could. And so Professor Umphrey, I had to take him back in for it. And he advised me to buy a trombone. And I agreed to do so. And he…
Do you remember about, excuse me, what year that was about? Was that...

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He used to be our teacher, Frank Welch.

ctx.x: All those old, little town grass bands.
Yeah. Yeah. What about Frank Welch?
He used to be our teacher, Frank Welch.
